sink.buffer: RTP timestamp-based, ~88ms negotiated. Spec-original receiver — B&W A5/A7 and other AirPort-Express-derived hardware match this wire behavior.
quirks: Reference implementation of the AirPlay 1 RAOP protocol. Other AirPort-Express-derived hardware (B&W A5/A7, Marantz NA-series, Pioneer N-50, etc.) reuses the same wire format with minor firmware differences.
Some firmware revisions reject et=0 unencrypted ANNOUNCE — historically Apple has flip-flopped on this. Try et=1 (RSA-OAEP-SHA1 with the public AirPort Express RSA key) if et=0 fails.
Same sync-packet source-port constraint as all AirPort-Express-derived hardware: sync packets must come from the source port advertised in the SETUP Transport header.

notes: SEED PROFILE — derived from public reverse-engineering references (shairport-sync, libraop, chevil/raop2_play). NOT verified on physical hardware. The B&W A5 / A7 profiles in this repo are the verified members of the AirPort-Express-derived family; this profile is included as the reference root.
